answers.goal: I aim to be a writer director who can turn the fictional book series I have been working on for past 6 years into a multimedia franchise. Beyond this I want to work towards intersectional representation and make films that highlight pertinent social issues, offering hope amidst today’s chaotic world.
answers.drew: The ability the create film and works of art that have the potential to move audiences, change perspectives and lives!
answers.seeking: I am looking to connect with cinematographers, actors and producers to find my collaborators and understand other creatives in the field.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is me in 25 years. There is a vision I have for the kind of creative and role model I will become in the industry and everyday I aspire to live up to my values of resilience, excellence and integrity in order to leave that kind of a mark on the industry and on the younger generation of storytellers.
